description: This file is a CMake module script for defining and processing a function called 'compile_aidl' that automates source code generation from AIDL files during the build process. It includes detailed documentation in reStructuredText format, explaining the purpose, usage, parameters, and behavior of the 'compile_aidl' function.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function that generates source files from AIDL files by invoking the AIDL compiler with specified options and parameters during build time.
